question: Does frozen PERF-S1 F2 Source-Aligned Header materially improve attribution of the dominant Performance to Marlowe in the exact PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 Stage while keeping Performance a shared Stage occurrence and preserving every other Stage variable?
single_variable: horizontal source attribution of the existing dominant Performance source header
excluded_variables: Performance panel position, size, border, background or opacity
dominant Performance quote copy, line breaks or typography
Recent Beats label, rows, order, density or terminology
Character/cone position, geometry, state, hue, texture or floor treatment
Archive causality, runtime state semantics or durable consequence meaning

source_authority.anchor_source: Frozen incumbent carrier geometry already recorded by STATE-S1; this comparison does not remeasure or move the Character carrier.

full_stage_translation.translation_law: Move only the existing MARLOWE source-header raster glyphs horizontally by +177 px. Do not render replacement text, move the panel or alter quote/history geometry.

glyph_mask_law.pixel_predicate: Within the search box, select a source-header glyph pixel iff R>45, (R-G)>4 and (G-B)>2 in the incumbent sRGB uint8 raster.
glyph_mask_law.source_pixel_preservation: Destination glyph pixels copy the exact incumbent RGB values from their source-mask pixels; no recoloring or font rasterization is allowed.

source_erasure_law.replacement_rule: For each source-mask pixel (x,y), replace only that pixel with the per-channel median of the incumbent pixels at the same x over rows y=574..578 and y=593..597 inclusive.
source_erasure_law.reason: Those fixed sampling strips are blank local panel background above/below the incumbent header and avoid quote/history content; only source glyph pixels are reconstructed.

destination_compositing_law.write_order: First erase all source-mask pixels under source_erasure_law, then copy each original source-mask RGB value to (x+177,y).
destination_compositing_law.collision_rule: Any destination coordinate outside the expected target bbox or any overlap with an existing non-background semantic glyph fails construction before scoring.

pixel_preservation_law.only_permitted_changed_coordinates: the 428 source glyph-mask coordinates and their +177 px translated destination coordinates
must_be_exact: all pixels outside those source/destination glyph coordinates
Performance panel frame/background outside source erasure glyph pixels
Recent Beats label and all four history rows
pixel_preservation_law.semantic_law: The only visual claim tested is whether existing explicit source identity becomes clearer through horizontal header alignment.

required: glyph mask contains exactly 428 pixels and exact expected bbox
all changed pixels are a subset of source-mask union translated-destination coordinates
dominant quote and Recent Beats rows are pixel-identical
shell, Production/Scene, right rail, controls and footer are pixel-identical
target glyph center remains within 1 px of Marlowe source anchor x=282
challenger and side-by-side board receive immutable hashes before subjective scoring
construction_preflight.technical_failure_law: A construction or preservation defect rejects that technical attempt before scoring. Repair may only conform implementation to this already-frozen algorithm; no translation, mask predicate, source anchor, evaluation criterion or F2 mechanism may change.

evaluation_criteria: F2 must make Marlowe attribution immediately clearer than the incumbent detached left-aligned header.
The dominant Performance must still read as one shared Stage occurrence rather than Marlowe's private card, chat bubble or direct-message surface.
The fixed panel must remain compositionally stable; source attribution may move inside it without making the panel itself appear to move toward Marlowe.
The aligned header must not compete with or visually fuse into Marlowe's cone/name/state carrier.
The quote and Recent Beats hierarchy must remain materially unchanged and readable as dominant current Performance plus secondary recent history.
The relocation must not imply Current Opportunity, selection, causal direction, Observation/Knowledge/Memory or durable consequence.
The change must not increase competition with Production/Scene context, creator controls or the right rail.
The relocated header must remain visually balanced inside the real Stage panel and must not create a conspicuous empty-left / heavy-middle artifact.
Promotion requires a material net improvement over PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; parity or mixed tradeoff retains the incumbent.

decision_law.failure_consequence: Retain PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 and close the F2 comparison without F2b, alternative translation, panel motion or a replacement attribution family in this gate.
decision_law.promotion_consequence: Promote only the bounded Performance source-header attribution successor. No Beat/history-density, Archive, motion, palette, runtime-semantic, implementation or ODR authority is created.

next_action: Commit and host-validate this preregistration, then construct exactly one F2 challenger from the verified incumbent bytes under this frozen raster-translation algorithm. Do not score until preservation checks and immutable challenger/comparison hashes are complete.
